field_notes.action: NONE | UP | DOWN | LEFT | RIGHT | A | B (controller output)
field_notes.controller: top_action, probabilities (7 softmax outputs), features (35 controller inputs), genome sha256, frozen=true, kind
field_notes.t4: mean pooled frozen-T4 activity per subtype (T4a-d), what the controller reads
field_notes.game: EVALUATOR/OVERLAY ONLY (RAM): map, map_name, x, y, window, battle, dialogue window run length
field_notes.speed_ratio: emulated game frames per wall second / 60

other_messages.episode_end: type, episode, seed, decisions, fitness, furthest_milestone, end_reason, watchdog, dialogue summary
other_messages.stats: type, stream stats from the SQLite store
